description: Set the iOS Simulator's own location with `xcrun simctl location` (runs on this Mac, not in the app). Unlike location_action, this reaches native code: map views' blue dot (react-native-maps, expo-maps, Mapbox), native geofence monitoring, other SDKs. set pins `latitude`+`longitude`; route moves through `points` at `speed` m/s (updates every `interval` s); clear stops it. Needs no Buoy in the app. The in-app Location tool, when on, still decides what the app's JS location calls return. Pass `udid` when more than one simulator is booted.

udid.description: The simulator's UDID. Required when several are booted.

name: sim_location
